title: Admin management UIs (Products, Testimonials, Giveaways, Portfolio) + Public testimonial creation with mossy-green glowing stars

requirements.summary: Implement full Admin Products management UI (list/create/edit/delete) with image upload and robust loading/error states, using existing backend product APIs and existing AdminRouteGuard protection.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin/products as a non-admin shows the existing AdminRouteGuard access denied UI; visiting as admin shows the product management UI (no 'coming soon' placeholder).
Admin can view a table/grid of existing products loaded from the backend (name, price, in-stock, requires quote, category, thumbnail).

Admin can create a new product with fields: name, description, price, category (optional), inStock, requiresQuote, and an uploaded image; saving persists to the backend and the list updates without a page refresh.
Admin can edit an existing product (including replacing the image) and changes persist to the backend and refresh in the UI.
Admin can delete a product with a confirmation step; deleted products no longer appear in product list after success.
All create/edit/delete actions show loading and error states (toast/alert) and do not leave the UI in a broken state on failure.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for admin product CRUD using the existing actor capabilities (getProducts/addProduct/updateProduct/deleteProduct) and query invalidation for ['products']. Use sonner toasts and surface backend errors clearly. For image upload, use the blob-storage ExternalBlob client class with upload progress. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable create/edit product dialog form composed from existing shadcn/ui components (do not modify frontend/src/components/ui). Include fields: name, description, price (dollars -> cents BigInt), optional category, inStock toggle, requiresQuote toggle, and image file input with preview + upload progress and validation feedback. Use blob-storage ExternalBlob.fromBytes(...).withUploadProgress(...) for uploads. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an admin products table/grid component that renders name, price, in-stock, requires quote, category, and thumbnail using product.image.getDirectURL(). Provide edit and delete actions with confirmation and disabled states while mutations are pending.

Replace the placeholder UI with the composed management experience: fetch products, show empty/loading states, render AdminProductsTable, and provide a 'New Product' action that opens AdminProductFormDialog. Ensure mutations invalidate/refetch products without full page refresh and errors show via toast/alert.

requirements.summary: Add public testimonial creation flow on Testimonials page for signed-in users, using mossy-green glowing stars for both input and display ratings, and prompting sign-in via existing auth flow when needed.
acceptanceCriteria: The public Testimonials page includes a clearly visible “Create Testimony” action.
If the user is not signed in, attempting to create a testimony prompts the user to sign in (using the existing auth flow) and does not submit data.
The creation UI allows selecting a rating from 1 to 5 using star icons styled as mossy-green and visibly “glowy” (e.g., glow/shadow effect); stars are not gold.
The creation UI includes inputs for author name (or display name) and the testimonial content, with basic validation (required fields, rating required).
On successful submission, the new testimonial appears in the testimonials list after query invalidation/refetch.
Displayed testimonial star ratings on the Testimonials page render as mossy-green glowing stars (not gold).

file_operations.description: Create a reusable, accessible star rating component (1–5) supporting both read-only display and interactive input. Implement keyboard focus/selection and apply mossy-green + glow styling via shared CSS classes (not gold).

Add global CSS utility classes for mossy-green glowing star styling used by both testimonial display and rating controls (e.g., fill/stroke color + drop-shadow glow + focus ring), without changing the overall theme palette beyond this requirement.

Extend testimonial hooks to include a create testimonial mutation using existing actor.addTestimonial and invalidate/refetch ['testimonials'] on success. Ensure errors are surfaced cleanly to the caller for toast/alert handling.

Create a public 'Create Testimony' dialog composed from existing shadcn/ui components (do not modify frontend/src/components/ui). Use useInternetIdentity to gate submission: if not authenticated, prompt user to sign in using the existing auth flow (call login / or show LoginButton). Include validation for required author/content and rating; submit via mutation and show loading/error toasts.

Wire the Create Testimony action into the public Testimonials page and replace the current rating star rendering with the shared MossyStarRating display to ensure mossy-green glowing stars are used consistently.

requirements.summary: Implement Admin Testimonials management UI (list/create/edit/delete) using existing backend testimonial APIs, reusing mossy-green glowing star controls with accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin/testimonials as admin shows a working testimonials management UI (no 'coming soon' placeholder).
Admin can see a list of testimonials with author, rating, created date, and a content preview.
Admin can create a testimonial from the admin UI (author, content, rating) and it persists to the backend and appears in the list.
Admin can edit an existing testimonial (including rating) and changes persist to the backend and refresh in the UI.
Admin can delete a testimonial with confirmation; it is removed from the backend and no longer appears in the list.
Rating inputs in admin use the same mossy-green glowing star UI (not gold) and are accessible (keyboard focusable / labeled).

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for admin testimonial CRUD using existing actor capabilities (getTestimonials/addTestimonial/updateTestimonial/deleteTestimonial) and invalidate/refetch ['testimonials'] after writes. Use sonner toasts in calling UI and propagate backend errors.

Create an admin create/edit testimonial dialog composed from existing shadcn/ui components (do not modify frontend/src/components/ui), reusing MossyStarRating for rating input with proper labels and keyboard interaction.
Create an admin testimonials list/table showing author, mossy-star rating display, created date, and a content preview. Provide edit and delete actions with confirmation and loading/disabled states.

Replace placeholder content with the management UI using the new hooks/components. Ensure create/edit/delete show clear loading + error states and the list refreshes via query invalidation without a page reload.

requirements.summary: Implement Admin Giveaways wheel UI: select active giveaway, view/add entrants, animate spin to pick a winner, and show winner history using existing backend giveaway APIs with graceful edge-case handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin/giveaways as admin shows a working giveaway management UI (no 'coming soon' placeholder).
Admin can select an active giveaway and see its name/description, entrants list, and winners list/history.
Admin can add an entrant as admin by providing a principal (text input) and display name; the entrant appears in the list after success.
Admin can trigger a 'Spin' action that animates a wheel/selector UI over the current entrants and ends on a single selected entrant.
After the spin completes, the UI calls the backend to record/confirm the selected winner and the winner appears in the winners history with timestamp.
The UI handles edge cases gracefully: no active giveaways, no entrants (spin disabled with explanatory text), backend errors shown to the admin.

file_operations.description: Create admin giveaway hooks for loading active giveaways and performing admin actions (addGiveawayEntrantByAdmin, selectGiveawayWinner) with React Query invalidation for ['activeGiveaways'] and per-giveaway refresh patterns. Surface errors for toast/alert handling.

Create a wheel/selector component that can animate a spin over the current entrants list and produce a deterministic selected index at the end of the animation (client-side). Provide reduced-motion handling and a clear selected winner display once the spin completes.

Replace placeholder with admin giveaway UI: select giveaway (or show 'no active giveaways'), display entrants and winners history, allow adding entrants by admin (principal text -> Principal parsing), disable spin when entrants are empty, run spin animation via AdminGiveawayWheel, then call backend to record/confirm winner and update winner history with timestamp. Show loading/error states via toasts/alerts.

requirements.summary: Implement Admin Portfolio uploader/manager UI with media upload progress, metadata editing, delete confirmation, and a category option for “What I have created for the community”, using existing backend portfolio + blob-storage APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin/portfolio as admin shows a working portfolio management UI (no 'coming soon' placeholder).
Admin can upload a new portfolio item with title, description, optional category, and a selected media file; on success it persists and appears in the portfolio list.
The UI provides a category option/value that can be used to represent “What I have created for the community” so items can be grouped/filtered accordingly on the public portfolio experience.
Admin can edit an existing portfolio item’s metadata (title/description/category) and save changes to the backend.
Admin can delete a portfolio item with confirmation; it is removed from the backend and no longer appears in the list.
The uploader shows clear file upload progress/loading and displays an explicit error message when the backend rejects a file due to size/type limits (no silent failure).

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for admin portfolio CRUD using existing actor capabilities (getPortfolioItems/addPortfolioItem/updatePortfolioItem/deletePortfolioItem) with query invalidation for ['portfolioItems']. For uploads, use blob-storage ExternalBlob client with upload progress and propagate backend rejections for explicit UI errors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an admin portfolio uploader component composed from existing shadcn/ui components (do not modify frontend/src/components/ui): title/description/category (including a dedicated option value for “What I have created for the community”) + media file picker. Upload via ExternalBlob.fromBytes(...).withUploadProgress(...) and show progress/loading + explicit error messages for size/type rejections. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an admin portfolio list/table/grid showing existing items (thumbnail via item.image.getDirectURL(), title, category, short description) with edit metadata and delete (confirmation) actions, including loading/disabled states.

Replace placeholder with the full portfolio management UI: uploader + list, and edit/delete workflows. Ensure mutations invalidate/refetch ['portfolioItems'] so updates appear without page refresh and errors are clearly shown.

Ensure the public portfolio filtering/grouping UX can recognize and present the dedicated “What I have created for the community” category value consistently (e.g., friendly label), without adding new routes/pages.
